files.caption: A case run the agent sent: the decision, the voice strip and each step it took ("Caller claiming to be protection police tells a driver to hand over a parcel at a lay-by").
The voice strip on a case run: record a voice note as the driver, take the agent's call, or approve by voice.
The 3D city from above: downtown, the river, docks and delivery traffic, all simulated live.
City tab: control the live 3D city (weather, time, incidents) next to what is happening and the cases it raised.
A truck crash injected from the console: the road closes and responders arrive while the agent works the affected deliveries.
A motorcade crossing the city under a rolling road closure.
The city at night: street lights, lit windows and traffic, set from the console's time control.
The container port: ships berthing at the terminal with cranes, tugs and trucks.
Opening a case run the agent sent and scrolling through its decision, voice strip and steps.
A truck crash injected from the console: the camera flies in, the road closes and responders arrive.
Cinematic camera tour of the 3D city (the "c" key).
The AI builder: type a business, press Make it, and watch the playbook tree being placed (the model wait is cut).
3D city: the President's motorcade under a rolling road closure, roads striped closed while traffic waits.
Decisions drawer: a case waiting on a person, the countdown, why the agent stopped, and the option cards (hovered, never chosen).
Home: the headline numbers, the case that needs a person now, and live activity.
How it works page, scrolled slowly from top to bottom.
New case: pick an example and see the messages split out, ready to run (not run).
Command palette: Cmd+K, type "res", jump to Results.
Playbooks: the default incident flow canvas. Show all, click a step to highlight its path and settings, back to Start.
Results scorecard: click a case set to filter, then scroll the table of cases and verdicts.

Case runs: pick a finished run (caller posing as protection police; clash check says the stories don't match) and press "Watch it think" to replay its saved trace step by step through to the message sent.
Console home: live status and the latest delivery cases waiting on the desk.
Decisions: cases the agent handed to a person, with what it proposes and why.
AI playbook builder: "Frozen food, cold-chain vans" turned into a checked playbook tree in one call.
Practice: run the playbook against stored cases and watch the score per version ("Getting better?").
Playbook editor: the default incident flow, from reading the messages through the safety check to send, ask a person or stop.
Results: every stored case, what the agent did and whether it was right.
